tagline: International Association representing European inland navigation interests
hero_kpi_rationale: The number of participants at the annual congress reflects the engagement of stakeholders in the European inland navigation sector. With 215 participants from 11 European countries in 2024, this KPI measures the reach and influence of the association as a representative platform for the industry.
company_description: Endeavour Mining plc, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a gold mining company in West Africa. The company also explores gold, copper, and silver. The company's projects include Houndé, Mana, Ity, Lafigué, Sabodala-Massawa, Kalana, and Assafou mines. It primarily holds a portfolio of projects in Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Senegal, and Mali. Endeavour Mining plc is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

kpis.signal: 215 participants at the 2024 Frankfurt congress, from 11 European countries (May 15-17, 2024)

kpis.signal: 80 participants at the first Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp (November 4, 2024), from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany
